motions.motion_text: Councilmember Corson moved, seconded by Havlick to approve consent items 3A through 3K.
motions.vote_text: The motion carried 6-0, with Toor recused on Item 3-A and Mock and Morzel absent.

motions.motion_text: Councilmember Eldridge moved, seconded by Poinsatte to call-up the Fairview/Longwood NPP Zone on August 6, 2002.
motions.vote_text: The motion carried 6-0 with Mock, Mozel and Riggle absent.

motions.motion_text: Councilmember Corson moved, seconded by Toor to accept the recommendations included within the Middle Boulder Creek Water Source Management Work Plan with the goal to copmlete feasibility of non-motorized boating on Barker by June 1, 2003.
motions.vote_text: The motion carried 7-0 with Mock and Morzel absent.

motions.motion_text: Councilmember Ruzzin moved, seconded by Poinsatte to adopt Ordinance No. 7216 submitting to the qualified electors of the City of Boulder at a special municipal election to be held on Tuesday, the 5 th day of November, 2002, the question of authorizing the City Council to continue a 0.15 cents on each dollar sales and use tax approved by the voters in 1997 through December 31, 2014, for public safety purposes, concerning fire, police, court and prosecution services; giving approval for the collection, retention, and expenditure of the full tax proceeds and any earnings relating thereto notwithstanding any state revenue or expenditure limitation; setting forth an effective date; setting forth the ballot title; and providing further details in relation to the foregoing.
motions.vote_text: The motion carried 5-1, Riggle opposed. Havlick, Mock and Morzel absent.

motions.motion_text: Councilmember Ruzzin moved, seconded by Havlick to adopt Ordinance No. 7217 submitting to the qualified electors of the City of Boulder (the “City”) at a special coordinated municipal election to be held on November 5, 2002, to increase the City’s Open Space sales and use tax by 0.15 cents per dollar starting January 1, 2003 through December 31, 2018, and to pledge the revenues derived from such tax for open space purposes; giving approval for the collection, retention, and expenditure of the full tax proceeds and any earnings relating thereto notwithstanding any state revenue or expenditure limitation; setting forth an effective date; setting forth the ballot title; and providing further details in relation to the foregoing.
motions.vote_text: The motion carried 7-0, Mock and Morzel absent.

motions.motion_text: Councilmember Eldridge moved, seconded by Corson to adopt Ordinance No. 7220 designating the structure and a portion of its site located at 845 Walnut, also known as the Anderson-Martin House, as an individual landmark under the City of Boulder Historic Preservation Code. The hearing on this item will be held under the quasi-judicial hearing procedures of Chapter 1-3 B.R.C., 1981. Applicant: Mary Lee and Charles E. Withers.
motions.vote_text: The motion carried 7-0, Mock and Morzel absent.

motions.motion_text: Councilmember Eldridge moved, seconded by Corson to introduce and order published by title only Ordinance No. 7221 approving a supplemental appropriation to the 2002 Budget.
motions.vote_text: The motion carried 7-0, Mock and Morzel absent.

motions.motion_text: Councilmember Havlick moved, seconded by Corson to introduce and order published by title only Emergency Ordinance No. 7222 adopting Supplement No. 73 which codifies previously adopted Ordinance Nos. 7125, 7193, 7197, 7210, 7211, 7212, 7213, 7214, and 7215 as an amendment to the Boulder Revised Code 1981, and setting forth details in relation thereto.
motions.vote_text: The motion carried 7-0, Mock and Morzel absent.

motions.motion_text: Councilmember Corson moved, seconded by Eldridge to introduce and order published by title only Emergency Ordinance No. 7223 approving and authorizing the issuance of Boulder Municipal Property Authority Lease Purchase Revenue Note, Series 2002A, in the aggregate principal amount of $725,000, and approving and authorizing a Lease Purchase Agreement for the purchase of 38.1 acres of land and all mineral rights located at 75 th and Arapahoe Road together with 1 1/4 shares of the Original Cottonwood Ditch and 1/4 share of the Enterprise Ditch from Edward H. Kolb, Frederick M. Kolb and John B. Kolb for Open Space and Mountain Parks purposes.
motions.vote_text: The motion carried 7-0, Mock and Morzel absent.

motions.motion_text: There being no further business to come before Council at this time, BY MOTION REGULARLY ADOPTED, THE MEETING WAS ADJOURNED AT 9:52 P.M.
